items.title: Pay dog-school invoice
items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Start event: Rechnungsdatum 21.11.2026 (printed invoice date), a private-law deadline, so §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188, 193 BGB apply. The day of the event itself is not counted, so the 14-day period begins 22.11.2026 (day 1). Counting 14 days: 22,23,24,25,26,27,28,29,30 Nov (days 1-9), then 1,2,3,4,5 Dec (days 10-14). Day 14 = Saturday 05.12.2026. Since the last day is a Saturday, under § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day. Sunday 06.12.2026 is also non-working, so it moves to Monday 07.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NRW (the payer's Land, relevant for payments to a company per §§ 269, 270 Abs. 4 BGB).
